standard-dialogue.player: Hey there. What brings you here?

standard-dialogue.npc: This is the dense essence mine. The essence we gather here is used across Arceuus, and indeed all of Kourend. If you wish, you are welcome to mine some yourself.

treasure-trails-medium.npc: I have a question for you.

treasure-trails-medium.text: Clerris has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-medium-when-talked-to-ag.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.text: [Clerris has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]

historical-dialogue.npc: The mages of Arceuus seek dense essence for their experiments. I see you have [amount] blocks; we require [amount]. Donations will be marked with gratitude.

steps.text: Dense essence is taken and favour is given.

steps.npc: Your donation has been gratefully recieved.

steps.player: No, sorry, they can't have it.

historical-dialogue-if-the-player-has-ma.npc: We do not require any dense essence from you at present. Thank you for your support.
